lessons.keep: Attach the product question directly to the scene it concerns.
try: For a live audience tool, show one yes/no prompt, one vote and the visible final result on the same clip.
Test a clean front-facing prediction card against the mirrored reaching-card scene for readability.
lessons.avoid: Avoid letting montage and funding replace a complete user action.
lessons.open: How are predictions resolved, and which scenes are live versus replay examples?
